import java.util.*;
import java.lang.Math;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static int MAX_K = 70;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            A = new long[n][n];
        }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = width();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum += this.A[i][k] * B.A[k][j];
                    }
                    res.A[i][j] = sum % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix power(long k) {
            Matrix result = identity(height());
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        int height() {
            return A.length;
        }

        int width() {
            return A[0].length;
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a;
        long exp = b;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        int indexLimit = 0;
        long copyN = N;
        while (copyN >= K) {
            indexLimit++;
            copyN /= K;
        }

        Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[(int) (indexLimit + 2)][(int) (K + 1)];
        for (int i = 0; i <= indexLimit + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = new Matrix((int) (K + 1), 1);
            }
        }

        // Initialize mat[0][0]
        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int) (K + 1));
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                mat[0][i].A[j][0] = (j == i ? 1 : 0);
            }
        }

        // Generate other matrices
        for (int i = 1; i <= indexLimit; i++) {
            // For first column
            mat[i][0] = mat[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                mat[i][0] = mat[i][0].multiply(mat[i - 1][j]);
            }
            // For other columns
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = new Matrix((int) (K + 1), 1);
                // Copy previous
                for (int rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < K + 1; rowIdx++) {
                    mat[i][j].A[rowIdx][0] = mat[i - 1][j - 1].A[rowIdx][0];
                }
                // Rotate
                rotateMatrix(mat[i][j], (int) K);
            }
        }

        // Compute answer
        Matrix ans = new Matrix((int) (K + 1), 1);
        ans.A[(int) K][0] = 1;

        long idx = indexLimit;
        long used = 0;

        while (idx >= 0) {
            long powerVal = beki(K, idx);
            if (powerVal <= N) {
                N -= powerVal;
                ans = mat[(int) idx][(int) used].multiply(ans);
                used++;
                if (used == K) {
                    used = 0;
                }
            } else {
                idx--;
            }
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            val += ans.A[i][0];
        }
        val %= MOD;
        System.out.println(val);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void rotateMatrix(Matrix mat, int K) {
        int size = mat.A.length;
        Matrix B = new Matrix(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                B.A[i][j] = mat.A[(i + K - 1) % size][(j + K - 1) % size];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                mat.A[i][j] = B.A[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
